# Posters

A dashboard of [posters](/cards/poster-card): each one an entity drawn the way its kind says, from the weather's condition and the sun's day to a wind field, the air quality bands of a CO₂ sensor and a person's photo behind the poster. Every card runs against a simulated home, so tap, drag and hold them.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Posters
      subtitle: "{{ states('sensor.outdoor_temperature') }} °C outside · {{ states('sensor.power_consumption') }} W at home"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", show_icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: weather.home
          name: Outside
          badges:
            - { attribute: humidity, icon: mdi:water-percent }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sun.sun
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.wind_speed
          name: Wind
          visual: { type: flow, style: lines }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.rain_rate_roof
          name: Rain
          visual: { type: flow, style: drops }
          wind: sensor.wind_speed
          direction: sensor.wind_direction
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: light.living_room
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: climate.living_room
          name: Thermostat
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: light.garden
          visual: { type: image, src: camera.garden, opacity: 0.6 }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: fan.living_room
          name: Fan
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
          control: false
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: cover.office_blinds
          name: Office blinds
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: vacuum.robot
          name: Robot
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.solar_power
          name: Solar
          kind: solar
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.grid_power
          name: Grid
          kind: grid
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.balcony_battery_soc
          name: Battery
          charge: sensor.balcony_battery_charge_power
          discharge: sensor.balcony_battery_discharge_power
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.power_consumption
          name: Power
          visual: { type: sparkline, hours: 12 }
          rules:
            - { below: 1000, color: green, label: Low }
            - { below: 3000, color: amber, label: Normal }
            - { above: 3000, color: red, label: High, style: filled, pulse: true }
          badges:
            - sensor.solar_power
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_co2
          name: Living room
          visual: sparkline
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.office_co2
          name: Office
          visual: sparkline
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.ev_battery
          name: Car
          kind: car
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          name: Laundry
          icon: mdi:washing-machine
          value: "{{ states('sensor.washer_remaining') }}"
          unit: min
          secondary: "{{ states('sensor.washer_power') }} W"
          status: "{{ 'Running' if states('sensor.washer_remaining') | int(0) > 0 else 'Done' }}"
          color: "{{ 'teal' if states('sensor.washer_remaining') | int(0) > 0 else 'grey' }}"
          tap_action: { action: more-info, entity: sensor.washer_status }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: person.malte
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.outdoor_aqi
          name: Air quality
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          name: Rooms
          icon: mdi:home-thermometer
          kind: trend
          series:
            - { entity: sensor.living_room_temperature, name: Living room, color: green }
            - { entity: sensor.bedroom_temperature, name: Bedroom, color: indigo }
            - { entity: sensor.office_temperature, name: Office, color: orange }
```

</DashboardGrid>
